name: Sellavant
canonicalHostNote: Always use the www host. https://sellavant.com/brand/* answers 308 to www, and partner/OAuth consoles frequently do not follow redirects when fetching a logo.

usage.preferred: Horizontal lockup for headers, email and partner pages; square icon for app tiles, OAuth consoles and compact UI; favicon variant (no trend line) at 16-32px.
usage.small: The small lockup is the compact cut: Inter's text optical size and a trimmed box, for rendering around 100px wide. Use the horizontal lockup above that size.
usage.clearSpace: Keep at least 0.5x the lockup height of clear space on all sides.
usage.backgrounds: The icon tile is self-contained navy and sits on any background. On dark backgrounds use the -on-dark lockups (cream wordmark) and the inverse icon.
usage.email: Email clients do not render SVG — always use PNG. Set an explicit width and height on the img, serve the 600px asset displayed at 300px for retina, and prefer the -on-dark PNG in any template that renders on a dark card.
usage.oauthConsoles: Use the square icon PNG: 512 for the Amazon SP-API and Ads app listings, 150 for Auth0 Universal Login. Point consoles at the www URL, never the apex.
usage.wordmark: The wordmark is Inter ExtraBold, converted to outlined paths. Do not re-typeset it with live text — Inter is not installed on the machines that render these assets.
